SparkScribe Privacy Policy

Effective date: the date of publication To confirm: filled in when published

Who we are: SparkScribe is a product operated by HRstudios LLC To confirm: postal address, optional ("we", "us"). Contact: contact.hrstudios@gmail.com

1. The short version

  • Your audio is never uploaded. Recordings are converted and transcribed inside your browser. If you allow it, the original audio is also kept in that browser so you can play it back later; it never leaves your device.
  • If you save a transcript, its text is stored in your account.
  • If you use AI features (summaries, notes, insights, Create tools, Ask, quiz grading, Focused Review practice, asking across recordings, combined study guides), the relevant transcript text (never audio) is sent to our AI provider, Anthropic, to produce the result.
  • Payments for paid plans (Flash, Bolt, Thunder) are handled by Stripe; we never see your full card number.
  • We don't sell your data, show ads, or use analytics or advertising trackers.
  • You can delete your account and everything in it yourself, at any time, in Settings.

2. What we collect

Account information: your email address and password (stored only as a secure hash by our authentication provider), when you signed up and last signed in, and technical session details our authentication provider records (such as IP address and browser type). Optionally, a display name. If you sign in with Google: your Google account's email, name and profile picture.

Content you save: transcript titles and text, speaker names you assign, timestamps, recording length, language and recording type, folders and favourites. If you use AI features: the summaries, notes, insights, study material, drafts, quizzes (and your quiz progress, including which concepts you're reviewing), and questions and answers they produce. If you ask across several recordings or make a combined study guide (Thunder), the question, the answer or guide, which recordings it used, and links to the passages it cites are saved to your account so you can reopen them on any device; the recordings' audio and full transcripts are not copied into them.

Your confirmation: when you create an account (by email, or the first time you sign in with Google) we record that you confirmed you're 13 or older and agreed to the Terms, with the time.

Subscription information (paid plans): your plan, its status and renewal date, whether you've had a paid plan before and whether you've used the Flash first-month offer (so it's used once), and the identifiers Stripe gives us for your customer record and subscription. Stripe collects your name, email, card details and billing address directly; we receive only the card brand and last four digits when Stripe shows them to you in its billing portal, not the card number.

Usage records: how many seconds of recordings you've transcribed and saved in each billing period (to apply your plan's allowance), and a record of each AI action (which feature, when, how many AI tokens it used and what it cost us). We use these to run the plan allowances and fair-use limits and to understand costs.

Technical data: our hosting and database providers keep short-lived logs of requests (IP address, time, page or API address, browser type). Our own log lines contain your account ID and a recording's ID, never its content.

Stored on your device (in your browser):

  • the original audio of recordings you transcribed or attached, so a saved recording can play back with its transcript. It is never uploaded. It is kept only in that browser: it doesn't appear on your other devices, and clearing your browser's site data removes it. You can see how much is kept, stop keeping new recordings, and remove all of it in Settings → Privacy. Deleting a recording or your account removes it from the browser where you do so; signing out does not. On a shared computer, remove it before you leave.
  • your preferences (theme, mascot, transcription settings), whether you've agreed to AI processing, small progress markers, and a transcript (with its audio) waiting for you to sign in, kept for at most one hour;
  • the speech-recognition models (downloaded once; not personal).

We use your browser's local storage and IndexedDB for these and for keeping you signed in. We don't set advertising or analytics cookies.

What we don't collect: your audio or video files (they stay on your device), your contacts, or your location.

3. How we use it

  • To provide the service: transcribe on your device, save and show your library, and run the AI features you ask for.
  • To provide subscriptions: apply your plan's allowance, show your usage, and keep your plan in sync with Stripe.
  • To keep accounts secure: sign-in, password reset, email confirmation, fraud and abuse prevention, usage limits.
  • To charge for subscriptions and meet tax and accounting obligations (Stripe uses your billing address to calculate any sales tax).
  • To keep costs sustainable: fair-use limits on AI features per account and a service-wide daily cap.
  • To support you when you contact us, and to fix problems.
  • We don't use your transcripts to train AI models, and our AI provider doesn't either (see section 5).

If the EU or UK GDPR applies to you, our legal bases are: performance of a contract (providing the service), legitimate interests (security, abuse prevention, cost limits), legal obligation (accounting and tax), consent (optional AI processing, where required).

International transfers: we and our providers are based in the United States, and your information is stored and processed there. If you use SparkScribe from outside the US, your information is transferred to the US, where data protection laws may differ from those where you live.

5. AI processing

When you use an AI feature, we send the transcript text it needs (lines with speaker names and timestamps; for Ask, your question and the most relevant lines) to Anthropic's API. We never send audio. Anthropic processes it under its commercial terms, which don't allow training on API data and keep inputs and outputs only for a limited period, longer only where needed to enforce its usage policy or required by law. AI results are stored in your account until you delete them or your account. AI output can be wrong: check important details against the transcript and the recording.

6. How long we keep it

  • Saved transcripts and AI results (including answers and guides across recordings): until you delete them or your account.
  • Account: until you delete it.
  • Usage and subscription records: with your account; billing records Stripe keeps are governed by Stripe's own policies.
  • Payment and tax records: Stripe keeps them, and we keep invoices and payment records, as long as accounting and tax rules require.
  • Logs: they expire automatically at our providers, generally within a few days.
  • Backups: our database provider may keep backups for up to 7 days; deleted data disappears from them when they expire.
  • Audio kept in your browser: until you remove it (Settings → Privacy), delete the recording or your account in that browser, or clear the browser's site data.

7. Your choices and rights

  • Delete: Settings → Account → Delete account removes your account and everything in it immediately and permanently. If you have a paid subscription, it is canceled at the same moment so you are never charged again. Single recordings can be deleted in My Library.
  • Access and export: you can view everything in the app and export each transcript and AI result (TXT, Markdown, Word, PDF, subtitles). For a full copy of your account data, email contact.hrstudios@gmail.com; we reply within 30 days.
  • Correct: edit speaker names and recording details in the app, or contact us.
  • AI features are optional: transcription works without them.
  • Depending on where you live, you may have more rights (access, portability, objection, restriction, complaint to a supervisory authority). Email us to use them; we may need to verify that the request comes from you.

8. Recording other people

Recordings often contain other people's voices and personal information, such as teachers, classmates or colleagues. You're responsible for having the right to record and transcribe them, including any consent your local law, your school or your workplace requires. Some places require everyone in a conversation to agree before it is recorded.

9. Security

Your audio stays on your device. Data in transit is encrypted (HTTPS), and stored data is protected by per-account access rules in our database: each account can only read its own records. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects you, we'll notify you as the law requires.

10. Children and teens

SparkScribe is for people aged 13 and older. We don't knowingly allow accounts for, or collect personal information from, children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has created an account, contact us and we'll delete it. If you are 13 to 17, use SparkScribe with your parent's or guardian's permission; a paid plan must be purchased by a parent, guardian or another adult. We don't share a teen's transcripts with anyone, including whoever pays for the subscription.

11. Changes

If we make material changes, we'll update the date above and tell signed-in users in the app or by email before they take effect.
